title: Double-Entry Karma — Burden, Credit, Debt, Transformation and Release
status: integrated project model with provenance boundaries
purpose: Explain the deeper structure implied by Tim Dooley's positive-karma, spiritual-bank, karmic-debt, Mud, Mountain, Spiral, Ladder, repair and Garden language. This is a synthesis of recovered material, not a claim that karma is an empirically measurable currency.
core_observation: The project is not best modeled as a single negative balance. It contains at least four distinct states: burden received, unresolved obligation attributed to another relation, positive capacity accumulated through endurance/creation/service, and transformed/released value after repair.

burden_account.question: What was carried, endured, absorbed or left unresolved?

obligation_account.question: Which relationship still requires truth, repair, correction, restitution or changed conduct?

positive_capacity_account.question: What constructive capacity has been built through survival, witness, art, knowledge, protection, service or cultivation?

transformation_account.question: Has the burden been converted into something that improves future life rather than merely preserving grievance?

double_entry_relation.project_logic: A single harmful relation can be described from two sides: unresolved responsibility appears as karmic debt on one side, while survival/holding/constructive response may appear as positive stored karma on Tim's side.
double_entry_relation.important_limit: This does not mean every harm automatically gives Tim a valid claim, nor that suffering mechanically creates moral superiority. Each relation still requires evidence and interpretation.
double_entry_relation.example_from_2026: The archive moves from 38.8T positive stored karma to similarly scaled karmic debt and later explicitly describes 42T positive karma owed to Tim as the reciprocal side of debtor-side liability.

transformation_law.formula: burden that remains only burden -> Mud/Swamp; burden that is examined, integrated and redirected -> capacity/Spiral/Garden
transformation_law.relation_to_april_turning: The April 2025 Turning states that a small final straw reveals a much larger accumulated burden. The later Ladder/Axis language then converts passive carrying into a connective function.
transformation_law.ethical_test: The archive should prefer transformations that create protection, understanding, building, service or cultivation over those that merely intensify accusation.

addition_operators.effect: adds unresolved burden when evidence supports the underlying event
can prolong an otherwise repairable obligation
allows consequences and costs to persist
refreshes old conflict and creates new traces
reactivates archived claims after quiet periods
multiplies attention, humiliation and third-party edges
creates narrative debt and possible reputational persistence
adds unresolved duty in vulnerable-life contexts
adds obligation when value, attention, labor or vulnerability is exploited

reduction_operators.effect: removes unsupported interpretations and clarifies real obligations
reduces false or stale narrative propagation
can reduce interpersonal residue when credible and appropriately specific
turns obligation into constructive capacity when relevant to the damaged relation
changes the mechanism that produced or prolonged harm
reduces edge creation and mutual fixation
allows a sufficiently repaired relation to stop generating permanent debt
removes entries that evidence shows were wrongly attributed

credit_operators.meaning: preserve truth without turning it into permanent spectacle
transform difficult material into creative output
turn stored value into durable capability
convert status or authority into useful action
create conditions in which independent future growth becomes possible

why_the_balance_mostly_rises.observed: Recovered numerical checkpoints mostly rise from 38.8T toward 42T.
possible_explanations: Tim was using the headline number as a cumulative rhetorical index rather than executing explicit transaction-level bookkeeping.
New harms/delays were being added while repair remained mostly conceptual.
Some reductions may have occurred but were never numerically announced.
Conversation recovery may preferentially preserve dramatic balance increases over quiet settlement moments.
why_the_balance_mostly_rises.archive_rule: Do not assume monotonic cosmic debt. Treat monotonicity as a property of the recovered statements, not a metaphysical law.

settlement_requires_disentanglement.problem: A relationship can be verbally forgiven yet remain structurally active through archives, algorithms, pursuit, litigation, shared audiences or repeated responses.
settlement_requires_disentanglement.strong_settlement: truth established + harmful mechanism stopped + relevant repair performed + third-party propagation reduced + affected parties regain agency + future interaction no longer compulsively reproduces the conflict

failed_settlement_patterns: correction hidden where almost nobody sees it
financial payment without ending abuse or pursuit
forgiveness demanded from the harmed party
institutional reform that preserves the same incentive
calling something repaired while the target still cannot leave the conflict

positive_karma_question.research_gap: The repository currently has strong Tim-specific positive-karma language but fewer examples of Tim assigning positive karma to other people for constructive action.
positive_karma_question.importance: If the system is genuinely relational rather than self-centered, it should be capable of recognizing positive credit in others as well as debt.

moral_accounting_guardrails: No collective guilt by nationality, ethnicity, religion or platform membership.
No criminal inference from symbolic Dog/Farm/Swamp language.
No medical event treated as karmic punishment or proof of prophecy.
No symbolic trillion value treated as legal damages or collectable money.
No permanent debt when evidence establishes non-liability or sufficient repair.
No historical erasure as the price of forgiveness.
largest_synthesis: The mature Potatoverse ledger is strongest when understood not as a supernatural collection agency but as a memory-and-transformation system. It asks what happened, what trace remains, who is still bound to whom, what capacity was created through endurance, what repair is still due, and whether the relation can finally become fertile rather than repetitive.
